related.title: OpenVEX：產品、子元件與不受影響聲明的適用範圍
related.titleEn: OpenVEX: product scope, subcomponents and not-affected claims
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：60%與70%可重算，錯元素及同名內容替換均拒絕；報告不把optional直接解讀成安全上不需要。 交付spdx-external-map.json、解析/完整性雙欄表與同名不同內容負例；只使用本地文件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 60 and 70 percent and reject wrong elements and same-name substitutions. Optional format fields are not automatically unnecessary security evidence. Deliver spdx-external-map.json, separate resolution/integrity columns and same-name different-content counterexamples, using local documents without external artifact downloads.
related.difference: 建立12筆產品/元件/漏洞配對，保存purl、版本、摘要、聲明作者及理由；本地假漏洞ID不可與真實已知漏洞結論混用。
related.differenceEn: Build 12 product/component/vulnerability tuples with purl, version, digest, statement author and rationale. Use clearly fictional vulnerability identifiers so classroom assertions cannot be mistaken for vulnerability advice about a real released product.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課消費政策要求解析到正確元素且完整性符合；規格可選欄位不等於本地安全需求可省略。計數只納入雙條件同時成立者。 10個映射中8個能解析，當中6個完整性可驗證；另外2個無法解析與2個完整性不足分開記錄。 完整可用率6/10×100=60%；補齊一個已解析映射的正確完整性證據後為7/10×100=70%。
本地接受規則要求產品與子元件識別都符合、作者受信任且理由可查；格式有效只是輸入門檻，不等於not_affected內容已被獨立證實。 12筆發現中7筆有精確適用且理由已審查的聲明，3筆版本不符，2筆缺理由；三類互斥。 可採用聲明率7/12×100≈58.333%；補齊一筆原缺理由且識別符合者後為8/12×100≈66.667%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The selected consumer policy requires resolution to the intended element and acceptable integrity evidence. A field optional in the interchange format may still be required by this local policy; count only records satisfying both conditions. Eight of ten maps resolve, and six of those have verifiable integrity evidence. Keep two unresolved and two integrity-incomplete cases separate, preserving both the retrieval result and the identity it actually returned. Fully usable coverage is 6/10×100=60 percent. Supplying correct integrity evidence for one already resolved map gives 7/10×100=70 percent, without pretending that unresolved mappings have become available.

Local acceptance requires matching product and subcomponent identities, a trusted author and reviewable rationale. Structural validity is only an input gate, not independent confirmation that a not_affected assertion is technically correct. Seven of 12 findings have exactly applicable statements with reviewed rationale, three have version mismatches and two lack adequate rationale. Make these categories disjoint so a single deficient statement is not subtracted twice. Usable statement coverage is 7/12×100, approximately 58.333 percent. Completing rationale for one identity-matching case raises it to 8/12×100, approximately 66.667 percent, while version mismatches remain inapplicable.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Kyverno verifyImages：摘要固化與attestor門檻
related.titleEn: Kyverno verifyImages: digest pinning and attestor thresholds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：60%與70%可重算，錯元素及同名內容替換均拒絕；報告不把optional直接解讀成安全上不需要。 交付spdx-external-map.json、解析/完整性雙欄表與同名不同內容負例；只使用本地文件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 60 and 70 percent and reject wrong elements and same-name substitutions. Optional format fields are not automatically unnecessary security evidence. Deliver spdx-external-map.json, separate resolution/integrity columns and same-name different-content counterexamples, using local documents without external artifact downloads.
related.difference: 建立10筆Pod映像描述，列原tag、解析digest、變更後引用、required與verifyDigest結果；每筆另列三個attestor與所需count=2。
related.differenceEn: Build ten Pod-image descriptors with original tag, resolved digest, mutated reference, required and verifyDigest outcomes. Record three attestor entries per image with a selected count of two, separating signature thresholds from digest-pinning checks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課消費政策要求解析到正確元素且完整性符合；規格可選欄位不等於本地安全需求可省略。計數只納入雙條件同時成立者。 10個映射中8個能解析，當中6個完整性可驗證；另外2個無法解析與2個完整性不足分開記錄。 完整可用率6/10×100=60%；補齊一個已解析映射的正確完整性證據後為7/10×100=70%。
本課要求至少兩個指定attestor驗證成功，且最終引用含已驗證摘要；門檻計數與所有證明內容條件分開，簽章有效不能代替predicate檢查。 10筆中8筆滿足兩位attestor，當中6筆最終引用也固化正確摘要；2筆雖簽章足額但仍使用可變tag。 完整准入率6/10×100=60%；修正一筆足額簽章映像的摘要引用後為7/10×100=70%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The selected consumer policy requires resolution to the intended element and acceptable integrity evidence. A field optional in the interchange format may still be required by this local policy; count only records satisfying both conditions. Eight of ten maps resolve, and six of those have verifiable integrity evidence. Keep two unresolved and two integrity-incomplete cases separate, preserving both the retrieval result and the identity it actually returned. Fully usable coverage is 6/10×100=60 percent. Supplying correct integrity evidence for one already resolved map gives 7/10×100=70 percent, without pretending that unresolved mappings have become available.

The local policy requires two specified attestors to verify and the final reference to contain the verified digest. Keep threshold counting separate from attestation-content conditions; valid signatures do not automatically establish an acceptable predicate. Eight of ten images satisfy the two-attestor requirement, and six of those also carry the correct immutable final digest. Two have sufficient signatures but still use a mutable tag, so they remain unacceptable under the combined contract. Full admission is 6/10×100=60 percent. Correcting the digest reference for one sufficiently signed image yields 7/10×100=70 percent, while another unpinned image remains rejected.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
